This '''woman''' was the matriarch of the Datch family, which included [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Tarrin Datch/Legends|Tarrin Datch]], his brothers, one [[Tarrin Datch's sister|sister]], and their [[Tarrin Datch's father|father]]. The Datch parents were the proprietors of [[Pellezara station]], in the [[Duro system/Legends|Duro system]].

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Tarrin joined the Rebel Alliance. Although he missed his family, he knew better than to involve them in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Behind the scenes==
Unlike Tarrin Datch's father, Datch's mother is never explicitly mentioned in the second edition of [[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'']]. Rather, the phrasing "Tarrin's parents" is used in relation to Tarrin himself and his siblings. This article makes a basic biological assumption for the [[Gender/Legends|gender]] specification of this character.
